subject: SIG follow-up: delegated provisioning exceptions + role-hierarchy export request
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@orchard-payments.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security@orchard-payments.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: export of role hierarchy + exceptions for delegated provisioning

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for walking us through the Redwood SIG answers last week. As we finish our internal review, our InfoSec team has one remaining ask around delegated provisioning and role exceptions. Specifically: 

- Can you provide an export of your current role hierarchy with any roles marked as "delegated" (where provisioning responsibilities are partially delegated to customer admins)?
- For delegated roles, we need a short justification field and a list of attributes that are provisioned via SCIM.
- A sample SCIM delta (create/update) event for a delegated user would be useful.

If you can include the SAML metadata for your IdP and a screenshot of the MFA enforcement screen for admin-level flows, that would close most of our open items. We aim to finish the checklist by EOD Thursday.

Appreciate the help — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Tom
Security Lead, Orchard Payments

(Attachment: orchard_sig_checklist.pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@orchard-payments.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: export of role hierarchy + exceptions for delegated provisioning

Tom — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you requested. Quick plan: 

1) We will generate a role-hierarchy CSV that flags delegated roles and includes a short justification column.
2) Dev will attach a sanitized SCIM sample delta and a small SAML metadata file.
3) I'll include an admin MFA enforcement screenshot taken from the console.
4) Priyom will add a brief note explaining how least-privilege is enforced for delegated roles and the approval gates.

We should be able to deliver the package by Thu 2027-04-15 17:00 PDT. If you need it sooner, tell us and we'll prioritize.

Action items for internal: @dev_patel to assemble exports and scrub any customer-specific identifiers; @priyom_das to draft the least-privilege note.

Hannah
Manager, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

> > Thanks again for walking us through...

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: export of role hierarchy + exceptions for delegated provisioning

Folks — I've created the exports and sanitized them per Hannah's note. Files attached: role_matrix_export_20270414.csv (CSV with columns: role_id, role_name, parent_role, delegated_flag, justification, scim_attributes_provisioned), scim-sync-sample.json (SCIM PATCH example showing add/replace to user.groups and user.customAttributes), saml-metadata-orn.xml (IdP/SP metadata with production endpoints redacted), mfa-policy-screenshot.png. 

Important implementation notes (short):
- Delegated roles are ones where the customer can manage user assignment via a delegated admin UI; critical permissions (service-level writes, access to logs, billing) remain centrally controlled.
- SCIM provisioning for delegated roles uses attribute mapping limited to group memberships and these customAttributes: ['department', 'employeeType', 'orchestrationTag']. No credential material is propagated.
- We are not provisioning MFA settings via SCIM; MFA is enforced at auth time by our IdP and our console policies require step-up for admin flows.

I'll attach the files to the outbound mail to Orchard and upload them to the secure Drive folder. Marcus, please confirm the redaction rules you want applied to the role descriptions column before we send to customer.

— Dev
Software Engineer, Identity Integrations

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@orchard-payments.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: export of role hierarchy + exceptions for delegated provisioning

Tom — attaching the package and summary below. Deliverables included in Drive link and attached to this mail (hashed for integrity): 

- role_matrix_export_20270414.csv (delegated_flag column = TRUE for 7 roles; justification text for each)
- scim-sync-sample.json (sanitized example of a PATCH event for delegated role assignment)
- saml-metadata-orn.xml (redacted endpoints; fingerprint SHA256: AB:3F:... )
- mfa-policy-screenshot.png (admin-level policy showing enforced step-up)
- least-privilege-note.txt (short explanation of approval gating and periodic attestation)

Summary (2-points):
1) Delegated roles: We allow customers to self-assign end-user roles (non-privileged) via delegated admin; privileged roles require a two-person approval workflow and cannot be assigned via delegated UI.
2) SCIM scope: Attributes synced are group membership + a small set of metadata fields; no secrets or MFA configuration are provisioned.

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Orchard-SIG-evidence-2027 (access: expiration 2027-05-01, password: sent out-of-band)

Next steps: Please confirm receipt and whether you want redacted role descriptions or full text (we default to redacted for external reviewers). Happy to set up a 30-min technical review if needed.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: role_matrix_export_20270414.csv (file), scim-sync-sample.json (file), saml-metadata-orn.xml (file), mfa-policy-screenshot.png (image), least-privilege-note.txt (file)
